description: Synthetic: a Claude coordinator's older message put a two-way choice to the user and said which it was taking ('I'm going with (a); say if you want (b)'). Since then it has written two one-line status replies to background-agent notices, the newest just above its empty input box. Only the final message can ask, so the older choice is history and the pane is idle. The transcript's last message (reply) no longer holds the choice, so the gate rejects it, and the re-read sees only the newest message.
